verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Drata has a trust center, but nothing documents it updating itself from the platform. Mentions of managing the trust center 'programmatically' via the API, an analytics dashboard, and branding/URL setup are developer building blocks or adjacent features. None of them show subprocessor lists, document renewals or control status syncing automatically to the trust center.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the trust center stays current on its own — subprocessor lists, document renewals, and control status update from the platform, not by hand
